title: TypeError when config file is missing
body:
Running the CLI without a config file crashes.

```console
$ npm install
$ npm test
```

```
TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'load')
    at loadConfig (/Users/bob/app/src/config.js:17:22)
    at Object.<anonymous> (/Users/bob/app/src/index.js:5:1)
    at Module._compile (node:internal/modules/cjs/loader:1105:14)
```
